svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Support Desk UI — The Agent Works Live, the Human Decides
A Blazor UI talks to the Case Summary Agent over AG-UI. Every tool call streams to the screen; the representative approves, edits or rejects.
AG-UI EVENT STREAM → WHAT THE REPRESENTATIVE SEES
Agent analyzes and recommends · the representative decides
"Third time! Still not here, I'm calling my lawyer."
Open carrier inquiry, inform the customer
WHERE THE HUMAN STAYS IN CONTROL
No write tools · reads orders, customers, stock, policy
Every step is visible on screen as it happens
Rationale cites the policy clause it used
Approve · Edit · Reject + note → decision log
Existing services execute the chosen action
Open protocol: the same /ag-ui endpoint could serve a React UI (CopilotKit)
